correctness.rationale: Conditioning on same and distinct uniform unit edges gives density f=2(1-r)/m on (0,1) + (2/m^2) sum_j H_j tau(r-j), where tau is unit triangular sum density. f(0+)=2/m determines m; recursive restriction to consecutive unit intervals recovers every H_j, so collision iff edge-separation histograms agree. Independent fresh exhaustive enumeration via networkx.nonisomorphic_trees for every n<=15 generated 7741 n=15 trees, 132 without degree-two vertices, reduced counts (0,1,1,2,2,4,5,10,14,26,42,78,132) for n=3..15. No collision before 15; exactly three n=15 histogram doubletons (25,26,24,16), (25,28,26,12), (37,42,12), all sums 91. Distinct canonical unlabelled instances ensure nonisometry. Finite exhaustive theorem only, no extrapolation beyond n=15.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks certify only stated bounded cases; universal conclusion rests on symbolic proof.
